newsitem.title: USA: U.S. barge rates steady to lower on call session.
newsitem.headline: U.S. barge rates steady to lower on call session.

text.p: U.S. barge rates were quoted at mostly steady to lower levels in bids and offers at the St. Louis Merchants Exchange in thin activity on Wednesday. No barges traded versus none on Tuesday.
- Two barges, Illinois River, next week, no bid, offered at 175 percent, unchanged from Tuesday.
- Two barges, Mississippi River (Osceola through Cairo), next week, bid 90 percent of tariff, unchanged from Tuesday, no offer.
- One barge, Illinois River, Pekin and South, grain or product, next week, bid 155 percent, no offer.
- Two barges, lower Ohio River, one each week of February 16 and 23, bid 105 percent, down five percentage points, similar, no offer.
- Two barges, St Louis, Mississippi, one each week of February 16 and 23, no bid, offered at 107-1/2 percent.
